item.title: Siemens Healthcare Diagnostics, Inc.: Atellica CH Urine Albumin REF: 11537225, in vitro diagnostic Recall
item.product: Atellica CH Urine Albumin REF: 11537225, in vitro diagnostic
item.summary: Processing of urine albumin assay on the CI analyzers may lead to the following issues: Falsely depressed Atellica CH Urea Nitrogen (UN_c) results; Falsely depressed Atellica CH Enzymatic Hemoglobin A1c (A1c_E) results; Increased rate of reaction cuvette QC failures and Delayed results due to QC failures. Product details: Atellica CH Urine Albumin REF: 11537225, in vitro diagnostic
